title: TMA-TNP Design
author: Heidi S Feiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bn2fmgbn

steps.title: Design Breast TMA Array
steps.instruction: Create a randomized array design for a breast Tissue Microarray (TMA) to be used for the generation of two identical FFPE blocks (TMA1 and TMA2).

substeps.instruction: Map tumor samples and cell lines to specific array positions (A01 through H11) as specified in the design layout.

Include a total of 89 positions, incorporating a mix of invasive ductal carcinoma, invasive lobular carcinoma, normal breast tissue, and various breast cell lines (e.g., MCF10A, HCC1143, T47D, BT474, AU565, MDAMB436).
Ensure the design includes specific patient IDs (HTAN Participant IDs) and corresponding Pantomics Reference Numbers for each core.

steps.title: Generate TMA FFPE Blocks
steps.instruction: Submit the custom design to Pantomics for the physical generation of the FFPE blocks and subsequent sectioning.
